notes: Non-profit run by licensed rehabbers Bobby & Cathy Horvath from their North Massapequa home for 20+ years (~700 animals/yr). Licensed at state AND federal level, so can take federally protected species incl. raptors. The usual go-to rehabbers for NYC raptors; will advise/help on anything, everywhere, with no hour limitation. Also offer sanctuary/placement for non-releasable wildlife. Email: (reach by phone; also on Facebook) Intake: Call directly (numbers at left). Listed as NYC-region rehabbers by NYC Bird Alliance
